statement.summary: Lemma 4.1 is frozen as two Props in Paper/S03_MobiusCoefficients.lean: `lemMobiusFEqMuStatement` (f(V) = μ(0,V), with μ mathlib's incidence-algebra Möbius function on the subspace lattice of 𝔽_p^d) and `lemMobiusMuClosedFormStatement` (μ(0,V) = (−1)^r p^C(r,2)). Up to paper v7 the lemma also contained eq. (cr), which v8 states as Lemma 4.2 (lem_mobius2.json); the frozen conjunction `lemMobiusStatement` joins all three. lines(V) and span J are literal project definitions in the same file.
deltas: 𝔽_p^d = `Fin d → ZMod p`; subspace = `Submodule (ZMod p) _`; dimension = `Module.finrank (ZMod p)`; the zero subspace 0 = ⊥.

μ = mathlib's `IncidenceAlgebra.mu ℤ` on the whole lattice `Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p)` (scoped Fintype/LocallyFiniteOrder instances; the latter is a Subsingleton, so the choice is immaterial).
The chain f(V) = μ(0,V) = (−1)^r p^C(r,2) is two separate Props with identical hypotheses; dim V = r is kept verbatim in the first even though it is unused there.
span J = `Submodule.span` of the union of the lines in J; rk J = finrank (span J) (the paper defines rk J in Lemma 3.3 for order-p subgroups of 𝒜; the evident meaning is used for lines of 𝔽_p^d).
p prime and d ≥ 1 as in the paper (NeZero p derived from primality).

maps.label: Lemma 4.1 = (f = μ) ∧ (μ = closed form)
maps.note: The displayed chain f(V) = μ(0,V) = (−1)^r p^C(r,2) is split into its two equalities (two Props, same hypotheses). The frozen `lemMobiusStatement` (frozen against v3.1, when eq. (cr) was part of this lemma) is their conjunction with Lemma 4.2's `lemMobiusCrStatement`.

maps.label: p prime
maps.note: Prime p in both Props. `NeZero p` (needed for the finiteness instances) is derived from hp by `haveI`, so it adds no hypothesis.

maps.label: d ≥ 1
maps.note: Kept verbatim although not needed (the claims hold for d = 0 too).

maps.label: 𝔽_p^d
maps.note: 𝔽_p^d is `Fin d → ZMod p` (ZMod p is the field 𝔽_p for prime p); a subspace V ≤ 𝔽_p^d is a `Submodule (ZMod p) _`.

maps.label: V ≤ 𝔽_p^d a subspace of dimension r

lean.text:
∀ (V : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p)) (r : ℕ),
      finrank (ZMod p) V = r →

∀ (V : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p)) (r : ℕ),
      finrank (ZMod p) V = r →

maps.note: dimension = `Module.finrank (ZMod p)`. In the first Prop (f = μ) the hypothesis dim V = r is kept verbatim but unused.

maps.label: lines(V): the 1-dimensional subspaces of V

lean.text: Finset.univ.filter fun L => finrank (ZMod p) L = 1 ∧ L ≤ V

maps.note: Literal: the subspaces L of 𝔽_p^d with dim L = 1 and L ≤ V, as a finset.

lean.text:
signedSpanCount V
          = IncidenceAlgebra.mu ℤ (⊥ : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p)) V

maps.label: f(V) := Σ_{J ⊆ lines(V), span J = V} (−1)^{|J|}

lean.text: ∑ J ∈ (lines V).powerset.filter (fun J => spanJ J = V), (-1 : ℤ) ^ J.card

maps.note: `signedSpanCount` is the paper's f, literally: a sum in ℤ over the subsets of the finset lines(V) whose span is V.

maps.label: span J = V

lean.text: Submodule.span (ZMod p) (⋃ L ∈ J, (L : Set (Fin d → ZMod p)))

maps.note: span J is the `Submodule.span` of the union of the carriers of the lines in J (the proof shows it equals the lattice join `J.sup id`, P03.spanJ_eq_sup).

maps.label: μ(0,V): Möbius function of the subspace lattice

tex.text: where $\mu$ is the M\"obius function of the subspace lattice

lean.text: IncidenceAlgebra.mu ℤ (⊥ : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p)) V

maps.note: μ is mathlib's incidence-algebra Möbius function (μ(a,a)=1, μ(a,b) = −Σ_{a≤x<b} μ(a,x)) on the whole subspace lattice of 𝔽_p^d, with 0 = ⊥; the interval [0,V] is the same as in the lattice of V. The scoped LocallyFiniteOrder instance is immaterial (it is a Subsingleton). The Stanley citation (Ex. 3.10.2) is not used: the value is proved.

maps.label: μ(0,V) = (−1)^r p^{C(r,2)}

lean.text:
IncidenceAlgebra.mu ℤ (⊥ : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p)) V
          = (-1 : ℤ) ^ r * (p : ℤ) ^ (r.choose 2)

maps.note: Second equality of the chain, as its own Prop with the same hypotheses (dim V = r is used here).

maps.label: (−1)^r p^{C(r,2)}
maps.note: C(r,2) = `r.choose 2` (0 for r < 2); evaluated in ℤ.
